name: Masked Firelight Strobe Reflection
use_when: A visible fire, screen, neon sign, explosion, or bright practical source should appear to affect nearby surfaces.
A still image composite needs local light movement so the inserted fire or glow feels integrated.
A full-frame flicker would be too fake, but a small reflected region would sell the effect.
avoid_when: There is no visible or implied light source causing the flicker.
The flicker would cover faces, captions, proof, product detail, or the main action.
The project tone needs restrained realism and the strobe reads as a gimmick.
The mask cannot be feathered enough to hide its boundary.

timeline_pattern.pattern: base_still_or_duplicate -> strobe_or_flicker_effect -> local_mask -> high_feather -> blend_or_opacity_adjust -> align_to_light_source -> preview_loop
timeline_pattern.locality_rule: Apply flicker only to surfaces close enough to the light source to plausibly receive reflected light.
timeline_pattern.mask_rule: Use a simple circle/ellipse or custom mask, then increase feather until the edge is not visible.
timeline_pattern.blend_rule: Use Screen/Add/opacity as needed so the reflection lifts light without painting an obvious patch.
timeline_pattern.preview_rule: Preview at full speed because a mask that looks acceptable on a still frame can pulse visibly during flicker.

motion.rule: The flicker should feel irregular or source-motivated rather than a full-frame blinking effect.

keyframe_values.mask_size: Keep the masked area as small as the reflected surface allows.
keyframe_values.feather: Use high or near-maximum feather when the reflected area has no hard physical boundary.
keyframe_values.intensity: Start subtle, then raise only until the reflection is felt next to the source.
keyframe_values.timing: The reflection should start with the light source and run only while the source is visible.

sound.rule: If paired with sound, use subtle fire crackle, electrical buzz, or room tone; do not add a hit to every flicker pulse.

captions.rule: Do not place captions over the reflected flicker area when the flicker changes contrast frame to frame.

color.rule: Tint the reflection toward the source color and preserve surrounding shadow detail so the mask does not look pasted on.

implementation.ffmpeg: Create a masked duplicate or colored light layer, animate opacity/noise for flicker, blur the alpha mask heavily, and composite with screen/add/lighten over the base image.
implementation.remotion: Use a masked light layer with animated opacity or noise-driven intensity, soft-edge mask metadata, sourceColor, and collision zones.
implementation.blender: Use a soft mask in the compositor or a light/glow plane over the reflected surface, animate emission or opacity, and color-match to the source.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Duplicate the base or add a light/effect layer, apply Strobe/Flicker only to that layer, use Mask with a circle/ellipse, raise Feather strongly, then set blend/opacity so only the local reflection remains.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Duplicate the clip or add a solid/adjustment layer, mask the reflected area with high feather, keyframe opacity or add a flicker effect, use blend modes, and nest if several reflection regions are needed.

common_mistakes: Applying the strobe to the entire frame instead of the reflected surface.
Leaving the mask circle visible because feathering is too low.
Making the reflection brighter than the source light.
Letting flicker cover captions or facial detail.
Running the reflection after the light source has disappeared.
qc: Is the flicker tied to a visible or implied light source?
Is the mask edge invisible while the flicker plays?
Does the reflected light stay weaker than or consistent with the source?
Do faces, captions, proof, UI, and products remain readable?
Does the flicker stop or change when the source light is no longer present?
